authority_statement: This is the single authoritative participant selection for the S01 implementation reference. It records what the participant has finished designing now. It is not an external approval, appointment, survey, construction drawing, specification, procurement record, field result, or activation authorization.

scope.applies_to: A zero-coordinate, carrier-neutral, reversible reference topology for deciding whether a genuine future physical task can ever justify a minimum P0 intervention.
excludes: rights, operator appointment, professional acceptance, or authority release
field observation, quotation, budget, funding, procurement, commissioning, or actual operation

supersession_rule.rule: This freeze governs participant design choices until a later version explicitly supersedes it. New organizer, carrier, professional, field, or authority evidence does not silently turn this reference into an approval; it triggers a documented rebind, accept/revise/reject decision, and an explicit successor or NO-BUILD decision.

truth_boundary.rule: Only the participant-authored reference, its alternatives, method, role topology and handoff logic are complete. Every real-world condition remains a future evidence question.

zones.participant_rule: Legible, continuous ordinary route; no walk-in queue, task occupancy, or AI dependency.
A human handoff steward confirms the conditional boundary before any task state.
One bounded task/device category only; no autonomous public-space activity.
Operation and human safety authority are visibly separate.
Observation is supervised, booked and non-queueing.
Isolation, quarantine, inventory and removal remain available before and after any future session.
Extent is deliberately null until a future competent assessment; no clearance or capacity is asserted.

canonical_s01_participant_reference_topo.selected_sequence: Z0 -> Z1 -> Z2 -> Z4; Z3 governs the threshold; Z5 is the stop/isolation/removal/reset route; Z6 remains null; every exit returns to Z0 ordinary city.
canonical_s01_participant_reference_topo.frozen_reference_envelope: 12 m x 9 m zero-coordinate conceptual envelope only; it is a typological reference, not a site layout or measured condition.
canonical_s01_participant_reference_topo.ordinary_city_floor: Ordinary route, ordinary training/work, maintenance access, human help and non-digital fallback remain first and cannot be displaced.

authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.label: ordinary city / NO-BUILD
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.reason: The ordinary-space sufficiency test is the default design conclusion; no physical intervention is justified until a genuine necessity survives admission.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.triggering_gate: Any absent, stale, contradictory, or insufficient evidence; ordinary-space sufficiency confirmed.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.failure_condition: Any route, rights, role, task, professional, field, funding, or authority gap remains unresolved.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.fallback: Retain ordinary city and record NO-BUILD.

authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.label: ordinary or lower-tech reversible solution
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.reason: If a future need exists but can be met without the frozen P0 edge, use ordinary room, simulation, review, or a lower-tech reversible arrangement first.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.triggering_gate: A bounded future task is evidenced but P0 physical necessity is not yet demonstrated.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.failure_condition: The lower-tech arrangement would still displace the ordinary-city floor or lacks applicable verification.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.fallback: Return to ALT-00 ordinary city / NO-BUILD.

authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.label: minimum P0 reversible condition
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.reason: This is the frozen Z0-Z6 reference, used only when a genuine, bounded physical necessity cannot be met by ALT-00 or ALT-01 and all applicable future gates close.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.triggering_gate: A real task, carrier, rights, separated roles, applicable professional evidence, field baseline, stop/reset rehearsal, funding/procurement authority and release evidence are valid and scope-matched.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.failure_condition: Any missing, expired, unsafe, conflicting, or unverified condition; any ordinary-space sufficiency finding.

authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.label: alternate linear side-bay
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.reason: This is the current secondary alternative when the preferred frozen reference cannot be verified, and only if a future professional process finds it preserves the ordinary-city floor and reversibility better for the actual carrier.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.triggering_gate: Preferred reference is rejected or cannot be verified after a genuine task need is established.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.failure_condition: It creates route, accessibility, maintenance, safety, rights, or restoration conflict, or cannot meet a future professional/authority requirement.
authoritative_alternative_hierarchy.fallback: ALT-01 or ALT-00; no substitute intervention is automatically selected.

items: Frozen Z0-Z6 reference topology is internally coherent and carrier-neutral.
Authoritative alternative hierarchy has one default, one first response, one minimum P0 condition and one secondary fallback.
D0 method definitions are complete as methods and contain no field result.
Transition, role-type, gate and receipt schemas are complete as participant design artifacts.
Bilingual reviewer-facing four-question closure is materially aligned.
Arithmetic and cross-reference consistency is subject to deterministic package validation.
A_PARTICIPANT_DESIGN_ACCEPTANCE.release_effect: R0 and R1 may be true; R2 may be package-ready only.

B_PROFESSIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.scope: Applicable planning, architecture, structure, fire/life-safety, transport, municipal/utilities, ecology, accessibility, privacy/legal, heritage, cost/procurement and operational questions.

C_FIELD_ACCEPTANCE.scope: Same-carrier route/accessibility, maintenance, task, interface, stop/reset and ordinary-baseline observation.

D_AUTHORITY_RELEASE.scope: Rights, access, appointments, applicable approvals, procurement/funding authority and final operating release.

release_state_model.entry_evidence: Participant design freeze, D0 methods, external-input contract, internal consistency checks.
release_state_model.allowed_activities: Package synthesis, bilingual synchronization and future evidence-request preparation.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: Claiming real site selection, professional acceptance, procurement, field work or activation.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Participant design acceptance receipt and complete handoff references.

release_state_model.entry_evidence: R0 complete and a bounded future evidence request can be made without asserting a site fact.
release_state_model.decision_role_type: participant author or future receiving reviewer
release_state_model.allowed_activities: Desk review, scope matching, evidence-request routing and no-build sufficiency review.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: Treating a desk review as professional or authority acceptance; field preparation.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Scope-matched request/receipt record or a documented NO-BUILD conclusion.
external_dependencies: future inputs may be requested but are not presumed received

release_state_model.entry_evidence: R0/R1 references, gap register, role and discipline questions, and rebinding method are complete.
release_state_model.allowed_activities: Receive, scope, accept/revise/reject future evidence; coordinate applicable discipline intake.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: Carrier preparation, procurement, installation, energization or field activation.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Applicable professional findings and a same-carrier evidence package.

release_state_model.entry_evidence: Applicable R2 findings, valid carrier rights/access, real task scope, role appointments and authority for limited preparation.
release_state_model.allowed_activities: Only authorized, reversible, non-activation preparation within the accepted future scope.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: Procurement beyond authority, energization, unsupervised task activity or public-route displacement.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Current carrier/interface record, accepted preparation record and applicable readiness evidence.
release_state_model.fallback: Remove/revert and return to ALT-01 or ALT-00.

release_state_model.entry_evidence: R3 evidence plus applicable separate safety authority, stop/isolation plan and independent witness route.
release_state_model.decision_role_type: future authorized operating lead with separate human safety authority
release_state_model.allowed_activities: Non-energized, bounded rehearsal of handoff, stop, isolation, removal and reset only as authorized.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: Live P0 task, public queueing, autonomous public-space activity or treating rehearsal as activation.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Dated witnessed rehearsal, stop/isolation result and reset/ordinary-baseline record.
release_state_model.fallback: Stop, isolate, remove, restore and return to ALT-01 or ALT-00.

release_state_model.entry_evidence: Current and scope-matched professional, field, rights, role, authority, procurement/funding and rehearsal evidence without contradiction.
release_state_model.decision_role_type: future authorized decision-maker with required separated cosignatories
release_state_model.allowed_activities: One future authorized bounded P0 session only; human stop authority remains absolute.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: Continuous operation, scope expansion, implied public-service dependency or activation without a current release.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Authorized session record, stop/reset record and independent ordinary-baseline acceptance.
release_state_model.fallback: Immediate stop, isolation, removal/restoration and ALT-00 ordinary city.

release_state_model.entry_evidence: After any future R4/R5 activity, a complete removal, inventory, reset and independent ordinary-baseline record.
release_state_model.decision_role_type: future reset custodian with independent witness
release_state_model.allowed_activities: Close out, archive receipt and retain/re-establish ordinary city.
release_state_model.forbidden_activities: New session while a deviation, missing inventory, unresolved appeal or restoration gap exists.
release_state_model.exit_evidence: Independent acceptance of ordinary route/service/restoration; any expiration supersedes active-release claims.
release_state_model.fallback: Keep no-build ordinary baseline and resolve only through a fresh future review.

consulted: future professional recipients as role types only
informed: future evidence owners and review recipients as applicable
gate_authority_topology.separation_conflict_rule: Participant design acceptance cannot self-certify professional, field or authority acceptance.
gate_authority_topology.fallback: Revise participant package or retain ALT-00.

gate_authority_topology.separation_conflict_rule: The future reviewer cannot accept an evidence class outside their competence or substitute generic context for same-carrier evidence.

gate_authority_topology.decision_owner_role_type: future rights-holder or authorized carrier steward
gate_authority_topology.separation_conflict_rule: No one person may combine incompatible carrier, operation, safety and acceptance decisions; absent appointment is HOLD.
gate_authority_topology.fallback: No carrier preparation; ALT-01 or ALT-00.

gate_authority_topology.separation_conflict_rule: The person operating cannot be the sole safety or independent acceptance witness; any conflict stops the process.
gate_authority_topology.fallback: STOP, isolate, quarantine, remove and restore.

informed: participant author and affected future recipients as applicable
gate_authority_topology.separation_conflict_rule: Human stop authority overrides activation; expired, scope-mismatched or contradictory evidence prevents release.
gate_authority_topology.resulting_release: R5 one bounded future session or R6 closeout
gate_authority_topology.fallback: No activation; ordinary baseline closeout or ALT-00.

setup.operator: prepares only within a future authorized scope
setup.handoff_steward: keeps Z0 independent and confirms human boundary
setup.reset_custodian: records inventory, quarantine route and restoration prerequisites
setup.independent_witness: observes required separation and evidence completeness

session.operator: acts only within the bounded future task
session.human_safety_authority: may stop at any time without operator override
session.handoff_steward: protects ordinary service and non-digital fallback
session.independent_witness: records only the defined future evidence

stop.human_safety_authority: initiates or confirms STOP and isolation

reset.handoff_steward: confirms ordinary human service remains available

review.independent_witness: cannot be the sole operator, safety authority or release owner

reset_failure_crosswalk.fallback: no further session; restore ordinary baseline

common_evidence_receipt_contract.rule: A receipt is valid only for its stated scope, role, method version and observation window. Missing, expired, superseded, contradictory or scope-mismatched receipts do not release a gate.

methods.purpose: Check that the participant design package is internally complete and truthful before external verification.
methods.observation_start: participant package review window; actual date=null
methods.observation_end: participant package review window; actual date=null
methods.numerator: required participant-design records that are present, internally consistent and truth-bounded
methods.denominator: all required participant-design records for this freeze
methods.formula: semantic completeness check; no field-performance value is calculated
methods.missingness_handling: Missing participant-design record=REVISE; missing external input=HOLD_EXTERNAL and is not counted as participant design absence.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Any inconsistency, unsupported claim or omitted participant decision blocks R0.
methods.participant_reference_floor: Every required participant artifact is complete and makes no external completion claim.
methods.validity_condition: Same package version and manifest references.
methods.stop_threshold: Any unsupported or internally contradictory participant claim.

methods.purpose: Define how a future same-carrier process tests whether the ordinary route and human service remain independent.
methods.observation_start: future authorized pre-open observation; actual date=null
methods.observation_end: future authorized post-reset observation; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future observed route/service segments without conflict
methods.denominator: all applicable future observed route/service segments
methods.formula: conforming observed segments / applicable observed segments; no value exists now
methods.missingness_handling: No same-carrier observation=HOLD_EXTERNAL; no inferred route value.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Any route, accessibility, maintenance, queue or human-service conflict=STOP and NO_BUILD for the affected reference.
methods.reporting_statistic: future segmented route/service observation with issue register
methods.segmentation: Z0/Z1 threshold, access mode, service mode, time window
methods.participant_reference_floor: No conflict is acceptable; this is a stop rule, not an observed result.
methods.validity_condition: Authorized same-carrier observation with applicable professional/accessibility review.
methods.escalation_role_type: future human safety authority and accessibility/community representative

methods.purpose: Define future evidence for visible human stop, isolation and non-restart behavior.
methods.observation_start: future authorized rehearsal/session start; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future stop events with human authority, isolation state and receipt recorded
methods.formula: documented conforming stop events / applicable events; no result exists now
methods.missingness_handling: Missing role, event record or isolation confirmation=HOLD/STOP.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Unavailable stop, role conflict, incomplete isolation or unauthorized restart=STOP and QUARANTINED.
methods.reporting_statistic: future event-level receipt, not an aggregate performance claim
methods.segmentation: rehearsal/session, event type, role separation, isolation outcome
methods.participant_reference_floor: Human stop authority must be able to halt and isolate before any future activation.
methods.validity_condition: Current appointment, authorized scope and independent witness route.
methods.stop_threshold: One failed or unrecorded applicable stop event.

methods.purpose: Define future evidence for removal, reset and independent ordinary-baseline restoration.
methods.observation_start: future shutdown or stop; actual date=null
methods.observation_end: future independent ordinary-baseline review; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future applicable components/routes/services with completed removal, reconciliation and restoration evidence
methods.denominator: all applicable components/routes/services in the authorized future scope
methods.formula: restored applicable items / all applicable items; no result exists now
methods.missingness_handling: Missing inventory, removal or independent baseline evidence=QUARANTINED.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Any unresolved item, deviation, service gap or restoration conflict prevents a new session.
methods.reporting_statistic: future receipt by component, route/service and independent witness outcome
methods.participant_reference_floor: All applicable future items must be reconciled and ordinary city independently accepted before closeout.
methods.validity_condition: Authorized future scope and independent witness distinct from reset custodian.
methods.stop_threshold: One unresolved restoration or inventory issue.
methods.escalation_role_type: future maintenance/reset custodian with independent witness

methods.purpose: Define future handoff evidence for S04 without creating an appointment or public-service claim.
methods.observation_start: future authorized handoff window; actual date=null
methods.observation_end: future authorized handoff window; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future handoff instances with a human explanation, non-digital fallback and receipt
methods.denominator: all applicable future S04 handoff instances
methods.formula: documented conforming handoffs / applicable handoffs; no value exists now
methods.missingness_handling: No authorized S04 carrier/task=HOLD_EXTERNAL; do not substitute a proxy service result.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Missing human handoff, inaccessible alternative or unclear responsibility=STOP/ordinary service.
methods.reporting_statistic: future handoff receipt by service pathway
methods.segmentation: service pathway, fallback type, accessibility need, appeal route
methods.participant_reference_floor: Human explanation and ordinary/non-digital fallback remain available.
methods.validity_condition: Future lawful service scope and applicable responsible role type.
methods.stop_threshold: One unresolved loss of ordinary service or appeal route.

methods.purpose: Define future evidence for an accessible human appeal and ordinary-service fallback in S07.
methods.observation_start: future authorized appeal window; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future appeal instances with accessible intake, human review path and non-public receipt
methods.formula: documented conforming appeal pathways / applicable pathways; no value exists now
methods.missingness_handling: No authorized scope or lawful review route=HOLD_EXTERNAL; no personal data is assumed.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Inaccessible appeal, loss of ordinary service, missing human review or public personal-data exposure=STOP and privacy/legal escalation.
methods.reporting_statistic: future de-identified pathway receipt, if lawfully permitted
methods.segmentation: appeal pathway, accessibility accommodation, disposition class, privacy boundary
methods.participant_reference_floor: A human, accessible, non-digital route must remain available.
methods.validity_condition: Future lawful data/privacy and service-process acceptance.
methods.stop_threshold: One material access, privacy or human-review failure.
methods.escalation_role_type: future privacy/legal reviewer and appeal steward

methods.purpose: Define how future evidence is checked for currentness, scope match, owner role and supersession before a release decision.
methods.observation_start: future gate review start; actual date=null
methods.observation_end: future gate review decision; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future required receipts that are current, scope-matched, role-valid and unsuperseded
methods.formula: valid required receipts / applicable required receipts; no value exists now
methods.missingness_handling: Absent, expired, superseded, contradictory or scope-mismatched receipt=HOLD.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: Any invalid required receipt prevents release and returns the affected state to HOLD/NO-GO.
methods.reporting_statistic: future gate validity register by evidence class
methods.segmentation: A/B/C/D acceptance, gate, scope, role type, expiry state
methods.participant_reference_floor: Every applicable future receipt must be valid; no partial release is implied.
methods.validity_condition: Receipt contract fields are complete and independently reviewable.

methods.purpose: Define a future decision record that proves the frozen alternative hierarchy was considered before any physical P0 choice.
methods.observation_start: future need/admission review start; actual date=null
methods.numerator: future alternatives with scope-matched sufficiency, impact and reversibility evidence
methods.denominator: ALT-00 through ALT-03 applicable to the future task
methods.formula: decision is valid only when the first sufficient, least-impact reversible alternative is documented; no result exists now
methods.missingness_handling: No bounded real task or missing alternative evidence=ALT-00 DEFAULT_SELECTED.
methods.explicit_failure_semantics: If ordinary city or lower-tech solution is sufficient, P0 is not selected. Any uncertainty defaults to NO-BUILD.
methods.reporting_statistic: future alternative decision receipt with reason and fallback
methods.segmentation: task necessity, ordinary-space sufficiency, reversibility, impact, evidence validity
methods.participant_reference_floor: Ordinary city/NO-BUILD is the default and P0 is never presumed necessary.
methods.validity_condition: Same-carrier evidence and applicable professional/authority review.
methods.stop_threshold: Any unresolved necessity, impact or release question.
